title: Season 40: Light's Calling - Preview
tldr: Season 40 brings back Light's Calling, the theme that debuted in Season 27: Angelic Crucibles let you Sanctify a Legendary item so it gains one of three random class-specific powers. The preview lists no class or item balance changes. Everything else is the usual rotation, with Season 16 cosmetics returning, easier Conqueror boss and Greed tasks on Torment X, a different Conquest lineup and new Haedrig's Gift class sets. The season went live on October 2 at 5 p.m. PDT in the Americas, five days after Season 39 ended.
highlights: Light's Calling returns: Angelic Crucibles Sanctify Legendaries with random class powers
The preview lists no class or item balance changes
Season 16 cosmetics return, plus a new pet and a new portrait
Conqueror boss and Greed tasks drop to Torment X
All seven Haedrig's Gift class sets rotate

changes.text: Light's Calling is the Season 40 theme, back again after Season 27 and Season 34.
Angelic Crucibles are a new seasonal consumable that can Sanctify any equippable Legendary item.
Sanctifying an item grants it a random pick from three class-specific powers.
Season 16's rewards return, including the Helm and Shoulders of the Conqueror Set.
A series of adventure-themed portrait frames can also be earned this season.
The Wings of Lempo return as part of the Season 16 cosmetic rewards.
The two new End of Journey rewards are the Taennin the Tiny pet and the Primal Hunter portrait.
Completing the Conqueror tier still grants one extra stash tab per season, capped at five in total.
The Conqueror boss task now asks for a sub-30-second Azmodan kill on Torment X at level 70, instead of Season 39's 1:30 Malthael kill on Torment XIII.
Killing Greed for Conqueror now needs only Torment X, down from Torment XIII.
Speed Demon / Need for Speed returns: finish a max-level Nephalem Rift on Torment X in 2 minutes or less.
On a Good Day / I Can't Stop returns: get three Legendary Gems up to level 65.
Boss Mode / Worlds Apart stays from Season 39: defeat a set list of bosses on Torment X at max level, all inside 20 minutes from game start.
Curses! / Stars Align returns: slay at least 350 monsters during a single Cursed Chest event as a level 70 character on Torment X.
Years of War / Dynasty returns: solo Greater Rift 55 clears using the bonuses of six different sets from a given list.
Sprinter, Avarice, The Thrill and Masters of the Universe, along with their Hardcore versions, rotate out after Season 39.
Barbarians receive Horde of the Ninety Savages instead of Wrath of the Wastes.
Crusaders receive Aegis of Valor instead of Roland's Legacy.
Demon Hunters receive Gears of Dreadlands instead of Unhallowed Essence.
Monks receive Patterns of Justice instead of Raiment of a Thousand Storms.
Witch Doctors receive Mundunugu's Regalia instead of Helltooth Harness.
Wizards receive Typhon's Veil instead of Tal Rasha's Elements.
Necromancers receive Masquerade of the Burning Carnival instead of Bones of Rathma.
